Early Access Game

Get instant access and start playing; get involved with this game as it develops.

Note: Games in Early Access are not complete and may or may not change further. If you are not excited to play this game in its current state, then you should wait to see if the game progresses further in development. Learn more

What the developers have to say:

Why Early Access?

“We believe a competitive trading card game is strongest when it grows alongside its players. Early Access will allow us to improve Origins and enhance the game with our community in a live setting. Feedback from real competition with real rewards will help us refine balance, progression, card accessibility, and the overall experience as we work toward full release.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

“We are currently aiming to leave Early Access roughly March 17th, 2027. This is an approximate timeframe and may change based on player feedback, development progress, and when we believe the game is ready for a full release. We will continue to share updates with the community as development progresses.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

“The core Origins experience will be available during Early Access. As development continues, we plan to introduce new features, more content, and make a wider variety of cards accessible to players. Community feedback will help us refine how that content is introduced while we improve balance, progression, and the overall experience.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

“Origins already features a robust competitive experience built around fast-paced online matches, simultaneous turns, three dynamic lanes, and a large pool of rotating locations with abilities that shake up the game. Early Access will build on that foundation by releasing new features and giving players access to more meaningful, tradable collectible rewards. We will continue to expand our playable card pool, refine balance, and improve the overall experience with help from the community.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

“No. Origins Trading Card Game will remain free-to-play and free-to-compete forever. Both during Early Access and after its full release. Early Access will feature some premium paid features.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

“Community feedback will continue to be central to the development of Origins throughout Early Access. We will keep asking for feedback through Discord, Steam discussions, and playtest feedback forms. That input will help us improve the competitive metagame, refine balance and progression, expand card accessibility, and shape future content and expansion sets. We are building Origins alongside our players to create a competitive trading card game they will want to keep playing and collecting forever.”

About This Game

Origins TCG is a fast-paced competitive card game with limited edition cards. Outsmart opponents, collect iconic characters like Mulan & Robin Hood, and trade to build the ultimate collection.

Every turn is both players' turn. Outplay your rivals in ~7 minutes. Battle in 3 lanes with unique conditions so no two games feel the same.

Rip packs. Trade dupes. Collect digital graded cards. Every pack is full of limited edition legends with marketplace value.

The best competitive games start with a level playing field.

That’s why every Origins player can earn all the cards they need to build competitive decks, for free. Spending money will never unlock stronger cards or give you an advantage in gameplay.

Collect rare, hand-drawn cosmetic variants of your favorite cards, then trade them with other players in the marketplace. Rip limited-edition collectibles, chase legendary pulls, and discover grail cards prized for their artistry and rarity, not their gameplay power.

Both players move at once. Simultaneous turns means no more waiting for your opponent to take their turn. Draw, predict, and battle across three dynamic locations. Outplay your opponent in ~7 minutes.


Every match draws from a pool of 100+ rotating locations that reshape the board and demand a unique strategy. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

Origins is an original world inspired by history's most iconic characters like Robin Hood, Queen of Hearts, & Winnie-the-Pooh. Earth got their names right and everything else wrong. Now the portals are open, and only the worthy may enter.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

In-game content
All card art, UI, writing, and audio are created by our team. AI-assisted tools are used internally for workflow tasks and temporary placeholders only. Non-English text in the game is translated with AI from our English writing. We believe an AI-assisted translation serves players better than English-only, and we improve it as we go. The game does not generate content with AI at runtime.

Marketing materials
Some cinematic sequences in our store trailer were created or assisted with AI video and image tools. Gameplay footage is captured directly from the game. None of the AI-generated trailer footage appears in the game.
